newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-PREMIER LEAGUE CHIEF SET FOR LIVERPOOL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PREMIER LEAGUE CHIEF SET FOR LIVERPOOL.

text.p: English premier league chief executive Rick Parry is set to quit his 200,000 pounds ($335,000)-a-year post at the end of the season and join Liverpool in a similar capacity.
The 41-year-old former accountant, a Liverpool fan from schooldays, will take over at Anfield from Peter Robinson who is to move up as vice-chairman after a year working in tandem with Parry.
Parry said on Sunday discussions were continuing but he would expect to give his notice to the premier league "relatively soon."
